description: Reference tuning and its drift (a histogram of spectral peaks' distance from the tempered grid), pitch-class profiles of the treble and the bass referenced to that tuning, the key as a note collection with its tonic and mode, and sensory dissonance, by Essentia and NumPy. Decodes again and repeats frames' spectral peak picking, which the bank does not hold: about twice the spectral cost (ADR 0074). Version 3 replaces TuningFrequency, adds the profiles, mode, and key regions, and moves chords to the chords extractor.

pitched.description: 1 where the frame sounds and its five-second block's loud peaks below 2 kHz agree on a tuning; 0 for silence, talk, and noise

tuning_frequency.description: the frequency of A4 the recording is tuned to: the confidence-weighted median of the confident windows; 440.0 with confidence 0 when no window is confident

tuning_cents.description: the tuning's distance from 440 Hz, in [-50, 50)

tuning_confidence.description: share of the sounding frames' loud peak magnitude below 2 kHz within 15 cents of the tuning; 0 when no window is confident, about 0.31 for noise

tuning_windows.description: every window of about 20 s every 10 s, centred midway between its first and last frame's centres (the last may be shorter): its tuning in cents near tuning_cents (0 when it has no pitched frame), the concentration of its sounding frames' peaks about that tuning (its confidence), and its share of pitched frames; a window at least half pitched and at least 0.4 confident counts towards tuning_cents

tuning_drift.description: the tuning windows that are at least half pitched; value: the window's tuning in cents from 440 Hz, near tuning_cents

drift_spread_cents.description: tenth to ninetieth percentile of tuning_drift's values; 0 for fewer than two windows

detuned.description: true when tuning_cents is more than 40 cents from 440 Hz, where a profile referenced to 440 Hz (frames/hpcp) splits each pitch class over two bins; chroma, bass_chroma, and the key are referenced to the measured tuning and are not affected

detuned_spans.description: the tuning_drift windows more than 40 cents from 440 Hz; value: the window's tuning in cents

key.description: tonic of the pitched frames' profile, as Essentia names notes (A, Bb, B, C, C#, D, Eb, E, F, F#, G, Ab); empty when no frame is pitched

scale.description: major for an ionian, lydian, or mixolydian mode, minor for any other; empty when no frame is pitched

mode.description: ionian, dorian, phrygian, lydian, mixolydian, aeolian, locrian, harmonic minor, or melodic minor; empty when no frame is pitched

scale_notes.description: the mode's seven notes from the tonic up, separated by spaces (F dorian: F G Ab Bb C D Eb); empty when no frame is pitched

key_strength.description: correlation of the profile with the winning mode's template, -1 to 1; 0 when no frame is pitched

key_margin.description: how far key_strength leads the runner-up's (often a mode sharing its notes); 0 when no frame is pitched

keys.description: windows of about 30 s every 15 s that are at least half pitched; label: tonic and mode (F dorian); value: strength

key_regions.description: the keys windows laid end to end, each keeping the stretch nearer its centre than its neighbours', neighbours with one label merged; label: tonic and mode; value: duration-weighted strength

chroma.description: pitch-class profile of the peaks from 100 to 5,000 Hz, bin 0 is A, referenced to the frame's tuning (the confident windows' tunings interpolated); not normalised; 0 below the level gate

bass_chroma.description: the same from the peaks from 40 to 250 Hz

dissonance.description: sensory dissonance of each frame's peaks within 40 dB of its loudest, 0 to 0.5; 0 for a frame below the -60 dBFS gate or with no peaks; talk and noise above the gate have a value, so mask with pitched for music
